term: excluded middle: logical holding, assertion policy or withholding package
resolution: Object-level holding ∀p,p∨¬p does not say an agent/stage asserts or knows every instance. The existing withholding package is derived from its explicit proof/assertion comparison inputs and is preserved; it is not object-level negation of EM. New policy-negative consequence has the exact universal assertion target. Controls compare the encoded marker subset only, not a full intended intuitionist logic or a historical classical interpretation. Separately, SomeExcludedMiddleInstanceFails is ∃p,¬(p∨¬p), not ¬∀p,(p∨¬p); its constructive refutation does not establish general EM. The serious withholding rival now targets universal assertion; exact global STMT-NOT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE remains an unrefuted logical alternative to object EM. Existing floor basis/justification remain, with disagreement metadata updated; no source/proof bridge, generic Other or new floor approval is invented.
